from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import Cut, MultiCut, Cartesian

# Define jet multiplicity binning (JetGood collection)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        Cut(name="j4", definition="(n_jetgood == 4)"),
        Cut(name="j5", definition="(n_jetgood == 5)"),
        Cut(name="j6", definition="(n_jetgood >= 6)"),
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        Cut(name="b2", definition="(n_bjet == 2)"),
        Cut(name="b3", definition="(n_bjet >= 3)"),
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of analysis categories
analysis_categories = Cartesian(
    axes=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)

# Configuration dictionary for use in analysis
config = {
    "categories": analysis_categories
}
